## Où j'en suis
The SRE take-home scenario is finalized for a strict three-hour window covering only Terraform and Docker Compose. It embeds a silent alert rule, a connection leak, and an overly broad IAM policy, accompanied by a scoring rubric without a hard cutoff. Files were extracted to a dedicated private repository, and distribution is deferred until after Thursday’s call.

- [prochaine-étape] Distribute the private repo link and README to Ethan post-call Thursday.
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch docker buildx --load failed due to daemon limits; switched to native Compose source building.
- [décision] Hard limit of 3 hours with Terraform and Compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] Force local source compilation instead of using pre-built images (source: t06)
- [décision] Rubric scores feed the panel discussion without a mandatory pass threshold (source: t10)
- [décision] Standalone private repo preferred over keeping files in the shared infra branch (source: t12)
